title: The Promise Left Behind
openingPromise: As Quixote’s visiting helper, find whether helping has actually helped by listening to those his heroic account leaves out.
duration: 12–15 minutes plus quiz; expanded conversation requested
sourceEvents: See sources.json; identical on all 128 routes.
studentRole: Witness and small practical helper. Never replaces Andrés’s warning or Pedro’s rescue.
harmon: You: returning student wants to be useful
Need: distinguish claimed rescue from real protection
Go: one-question journal to dawn road
Search: listen to Andrés and question promise
Find: apparent rescue secured by oath
Take: unseen retaliation and failed merchant charge
Return: help Pedro bring Quixote home, then return safely
Change: judge help by its consequences, not its heroic description

background.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create a 16:9 visual-novel background for Don Quixote Part I chapters 4–5: rural La Mancha, Spain, early seventeenth century. A dusty open road across dry ochre countryside, a small oak thicket at the right edge, distant low hills and pale blue morning sky. No people, animals, weapons, text or buildings in the foreground. Match simple manga-inspired vector characters: clean dark slate outlines, flat muted colours, restrained two-tone cel shadows, simplified geometric scenery, no photorealistic surfaces or painterly texture. Eye-level camera, broad clear central foreground for standing characters, useful scenery at edges. Keep contrast subdued behind actors. Full landscape frame, no border.
